cpuQuantizers.planScope: CPU kernels: quantizer and repeated preparation overhead, preserving packed arithmetic and rejection semantics.
cpuQuantizers.change: Private immutable FiniteActivations carries the original complete-input preflight into Q8_K, Q8_0 and pinned PTQ1 preparation. Scalar and baseline NEON max passes omit already-proven input finite predicates and associated NEON mask reductions.
cpuQuantizers.sourceReduction: 5,120 repeated finite predicates per 5,120-column preparation; maximum traversal and every scale, code, rounding and output check remain.
cpuQuantizers.correctness: Original standalone quantizers remain checked. New controls compare every scale/code/sum bit under generic and pinned contracts, with signed zero, subnormals, negative maximum ties, later NaN versus earlier scale overflow, shape/format precedence, stale-layout invalidation, retained storage, failure clearing and recovery.
cpuQuantizers.resources: Call-scoped borrowed proof; no retained allocation. Conservative resource admission remains charged. Scalar execution remains subject to portable owning checks.

swiftSampler.planScope: Runtime and correctness: bounded Swift top-20 sampler and per-token preparation overhead.
swiftSampler.change: The production sorted fixed Swift chain retains TopP's unnormalized binary32 exponentials for Distribution in an 80-byte stack array, omitting up to twenty repeated exp calls per token.
swiftSampler.correctness: Original generic sampler chain remains the independent oracle and unsorted fallback. Native f32 TopP normalization/thresholds, inactive backing probabilities, f64 Distribution sum and normalization, singleton draw, selected token, reset, clone and RNG ordering remain exact. New controls cover widths 1/2/19/20, finite extremes, overflowed subtraction, subnormal weights, ties, rejected guards and fallback; dependent stop/transaction controls are selected.
swiftSampler.resources: Fixed 80-byte call-local stack payload; no retained cache or heap allocation. No admission reduction.

nativeQ2.planScope: Chosen Hexagon milestone: reduce host dispatch/output overhead without changing signed computation or placement.
nativeQ2.change: Scalar and two/three-sibling single-token resident projections carry immutable finite-output evidence from native checked copy through borrowed, owned and public wrappers. Executor consumption binds every ordered original destination pointer and length before completed statistics can publish.
nativeQ2.sourceReduction: One repeated finite predicate and four nominal read bytes per selected output row; actual traffic and latency are unmeasured.
nativeQ2.correctness: Public evidence construction scans arbitrary submitters' output. Only the native crate can reuse an existing checked-copy result. Exact borrowed slices cannot mutate before consumption. Foreign, reordered and partial evidence rejects terminally. Native fake queues reject poisoned scalar and final-sibling replies, clear outputs and preserve completed counters. Transient, multitoken, fused FFN and partial-row accumulation validation remains.
nativeQ2.diagnosticChange: A custom submitter reporting success with nonfinite output now fails with native-rpc-contract-failed instead of nonfinite Hexagon projection value. Both are terminal, clear all output and publish no completed counters. Submission-returned failures retain their existing diagnostic/stage.
nativeQ2.resources: Fixed stack arrays of slice borrows/destination pairs; no heap allocation. Signed kernels, packet bytes, operation order, lifetime limits, conservative resources and defaults remain unchanged.
